summary:
Final static-source disposition: no new or still-open findings beyond documented residual risks. All three requested fixes are closed in source. HEAD matches the requested SHA; working tree unchanged. Read-only, no network; tests were inspected but not executed. This review does not establish deployed behavior.

D18 final disposition table:
Risk | Disposition | Evidence
SECR8-003: pre-reset proofs authorize high-risk staff actions | closed | backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/security/StaffAssurance.java:23-25 reads the account reset epoch; :55-59 rejects earlier proofs independently of policy mode. Scenario: a recently authenticated staff bearer token issued before reset now receives STEP_UP_REQUIRED. Regression coverage exists in backend/app/src/test/java/com/matbakhy/app/security/StaffAssuranceTest.java:56-66.
SECR8-002 / SECR7-003: destructive reset without durable attempt audit | closed | backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/mfa/MfaAdminController.java:99-104 writes the attempt before recording reset or calling the provider. The controller has no enclosing transaction; backend/modules/operations/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/operations/internal/JdbcAuditLog.java:21-27 synchronously inserts the audit entry. An insert failure stops execution before destructive work. Partial failures are additionally audited at MfaAdminController.java:111-118.
SECR8-004: generated development realm readable by other host users | closed | scripts/dev.sh:58-66 sets the generated parent directory to 0700 before rendering secrets. Inner 0755/0644 permissions do not permit other users to traverse that parent.
SECR7-001: reset leaves application sessions authorized | closed | MfaAdminController.java:103-110 records reset first and ends provider/application sessions; backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/mfa/ApplicationSessions.java:20-23 deletes indexed Spring sessions. backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/mfa/MfaPolicyService.java:53-61 rejects pre-reset MFA assertions; StaffAssurance.java:55-59 applies the same boundary to privileged actions.
SECR7-002 / SECR8-001: DISABLED enrolment/use | open-by-documented-decision | docs/security/mfa-policy.md:42 explicitly accepts direct provider enrolment and anonymous step-up. Application controls remain at backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/mfa/MfaController.java:103-110 and backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/security/SecurityConfiguration.java:261-278; staff retain independent high-risk step-up.
REQUIRED category precedence / preference override | closed | MfaPolicyService.java:124-136 selects the strongest applicable mode, defaults missing rows to REQUIRED, and prevents preference from weakening REQUIRED.
REQUIRED endpoint bypass | mitigated | backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/security/MfaEnforcementFilter.java:40-71 enforces current database policy with recovery/public exceptions; SecurityConfiguration.java:166,216 installs enforcement on both chains. MfaController.java:103-121 independently guards the exempt settings mutation. No concrete protected mutation bypass identified.
Claims confusion | mitigated | SecurityConfiguration.java:66-78 validates signed JWTs, timestamps, issuer and audience; StaffAssurance.java:39-44 consumes provider ACR/AMR. Provider issuance and SSO semantics remain runtime verification concerns.
Reset epoch / staff auth_time | closed | MfaPolicyService.java:53-61 and StaffAssurance.java:53-59 reject authentication older than reset. No concrete attacker-controlled signed future-auth_time scenario established.
Downgrade / reset authorization | mitigated | MfaAdminController.java:72-95 requires dedicated permission, recent MFA, validated reason and no self-reset; MfaPolicyService.java:148-167 checks policy version and audits changes. MfaController.java:112-128 guards weakening and ends sessions.
Lock-out / recovery availability | open-by-documented-decision | docs/security/mfa-policy.md:35,39-40 records live-realm verification and mobile limitations with rollout guidance. SecurityConfiguration.java:270-278 preserves staff step-up under DISABLED.
Previously issued access-token lifetime | open-by-documented-decision | docs/security/mfa-policy.md:41 accepts validity up to five minutes; reset epochs nevertheless invalidate earlier MFA proofs in both enforcement paths cited above.
Admin service-account scope | mitigated | backend/app/src/main/java/com/matbakhy/app/mfa/KeycloakAdmin.java:124-154 uses credential listing, OTP deletion and logout; deploy/web-preview/Caddyfile:89 blocks administrative paths; infra/compose.yaml:34 binds local identity to loopback. Broader manage-users authority remains documented at docs/security/mfa-policy.md:45.
Preview configuration / templates / logging | mitigated | deploy/web-preview/deploy.sh:64,77-79 protects generated parent directories; .gitignore:32-39 excludes generated configuration. KeycloakAdmin.java:82-91,129-130,145-156 logs status or exception class rather than response bodies or tokens. Actual deployed permissions/log contents were not verified.
Provider-only factors / application OTP storage | mitigated | KeycloakAdmin.java:124-139 extracts only credential type/id; backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration/V31__mfa_policy.sql:5-27 stores policy, preference and reset metadata. Provider response secrecy requires runtime evidence.
PREVIEW defaults | closed | V31__mfa_policy.sql:13-14 seeds OPTIONAL for all categories.
Factor coverage | open-by-documented-decision | docs/security/mfa-policy.md:43-44 records ACR-based enrolment assertions and TOTP-only scope.
